name: generate-tests-from-implementation
description: Multi-tool workflow: read_file to understand EditFileTool error paths, then write_file to create edge case tests. Tests read_file + write_file pipeline.
task: Read Sources/Yrden/Tools/EditFileTool.swift and study its error handling and edge cases. Then write a new test file at Tests/YrdenTests/Unit/Tools/EditFileEdgeCaseTests.swift that covers at least these edge cases: (1) empty old_string should return an error, (2) old_string equal to new_string should return an error, (3) file not found should return an error, (4) multiple matches without replace_all should return an error mentioning the count, (5) replace_all with multiple matches should succeed. Write valid Swift test code using XCTest conventions. The tests should be unit-test style — they can test the logic conceptually, and should reference the actual error messages from EditFileTool.

Tests/YrdenTests/Unit/Tools/EditFileEdge: old_string and new_string are the same
